name: Production account browser QA
isolation: Remote test-env, loopback-only network namespace, explicit synthetic configuration, separate ephemeral databases, no external credentials or writes
fixturePolicy: Passwords are generated in memory and omitted from evidence. Cookies, tokens, request bodies, and response headers are never saved.

Ordinary account has no Accounts navigation and account API access is forbidden

Administrator disabling an account revokes its session and denies subsequent sign-in
The last enabled administrator cannot be disabled or demoted and sees an actionable conflict
Administrator logout and browser console finish cleanly
